title: Preview releases are annoying
summary: The requested change concerns GitHub release-notification subscription behavior and the project's deliberate Canary/preview-release policy. Maintainers have publicly explained that GitHub does not provide the requested filtering control and that preview releases will continue for now.

status.label: not actionable
status.detail: Do not start engineering work in PowerToys; retain the maintainer explanation that this is a GitHub notification limitation and an intentional release-process decision.

judgment.rationale: The requested change concerns GitHub release-notification subscription behavior and the project's deliberate Canary/preview-release policy. Maintainers have publicly explained that GitHub does not provide the requested filtering control and that preview releases will continue for now.
evidence: The issue asks PowerToys to stop publishing preview releases or avoid triggering release notifications for users watching releases.
Maintainers explain that preview builds are intentional Canary builds used for earlier testing and validation.
Maintainers state that GitHub's release notification behavior cannot currently be selectively filtered by stable versus preview releases.
The discussion records that no short-term change to the preview-release process is planned.
The reporter ultimately requests closure rather than supplying a new technical defect.
judgment.recommended_action: Do not start engineering work in PowerToys; retain the maintainer explanation that this is a GitHub notification limitation and an intentional release-process decision.
